query: Recent French 2027 presidential first-round voting intention polls testing Marine Le Pen by name, June-July 2026, with pollster, fieldwork dates, and Le Pen percentage. Include Ifop, Harris Interactive, Toluna, Elabe, Odoxa, IFOP polls.
answer:
I've compiled the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on French 2027 presidential first-round polls testing Marine Le Pen by name, June–July 2026:

**Critical context:** Marine Le Pen officially declared her candidacy on **July 7, 2026**, which split the polling window into two phases — before (mostly testing Bardella as the RN candidate) and after (testing Le Pen directly, showing a ~4-point surge).

**July polls (Le Pen by name, post-announcement):**
- **Ifop** (LCI/Le Figaro): Le Pen **36%** (up +4 pts)
- **OpinionWay** (Les Échos/Radio Classique), fieldwork 8–9 July, n=963: Le Pen **34–36%** depending on scenario
- **Toluna Harris Interactive** (RTL/M6), ~8–9 July: Le Pen **34–36%** across 5 scenarios
- **Elabe** (BFMTV/La Tribune Dimanche), ~9–10 July: Le Pen **34–35.5%** across 5 scenarios
- **Ifop** (Paris Match): filed ~July 14

**June polls (Le Pen tested only in select scenarios; Bardella otherwise):**
- **Ifop**, 25 June: Le Pen **32%** in two scenarios (Bardella 35–37% in others)
- **Ipsos-BVA** (Le Parisien), 1 June: Le Pen **31–32%** (Bardella 33.5–36% otherwise)
- **OpinionWay**, 14 June: tested Bardella only (not Le Pen by name)

**Key patterns:** Le Pen's first-round range was ~31–36%, always leading. Her scores rose from 31–33% (pre-announcement) to 34–36% (post-announcement). Édouard Philippe (18–22%) was her top rival, with Mélenchon (13–16%) and Attal (7–16%) contesting second place. **Odoxa** in this period tested Bardella rather than Le Pen by name.

One caveat worth flagging: the exact Le Pen percentages for the Toluna Harris, Elabe, Ifop, and Ipsos-BVA scenarios come from the EPOC Info aggregator, whose row dates appear to be publication rather than fieldwork dates — I cross-validated the headline Ifop (36%) and OpinionWay (35%/n=963) figures against primary sources (Ifop.com, CNews).

key_facts: Marine Le Pen officially announced her 2027 presidential candidacy on July 7, 2026 (TF1 8pm news), after the Paris appeals court reduced her sentence to enable a candidacy.
Ifop (LCI/Le Figaro) post-July 7: Le Pen 36% in first round (up +4 points in two weeks), ahead of Philippe (19%), Attal (15%), Mélenchon (15%).
OpinionWay (Les Échos/Radio Classique), fieldwork 8–9 July 2026, n=963: Le Pen 35% (Philippe+Attal scenario), 36% (Attal-only), 34% (Philippe-only); led in every scenario.
Toluna Harris Interactive (RTL/M6), ~8–9 July 2026: Le Pen 34–36% across five first-round scenarios.
Elabe (BFMTV/La Tribune Dimanche), fieldwork ~9–10 July 2026: Le Pen 34–35.5% across five scenarios; 'nettement en tête'.
In June 2026 most pollsters still tested Jordan Bardella (33–37%) as RN candidate, not Le Pen, since she had not yet declared.
Ifop 25 June 2026: Le Pen tested by name at 32% in two scenarios (Bardella 35–37% in others).
Ipsos-BVA (Le Parisien) 1 June 2026: Le Pen 31% and 32% in two of eight scenarios (Bardella 33.5–36% otherwise).
Toluna Harris Interactive (M6/RTL), fieldwork 25–27 May 2026, n=1,744: Le Pen 31–32% / Bardella 32–34%.
Le Pen's first-round range June–July 2026 was ~31–36%, always leading; her scores rose from 31–33% pre-announcement to 34–36% post-announcement.
Édouard Philippe (18–22%) was consistently Le Pen's top first-round rival, with Mélenchon (13–16%) and Attal (7–16%) contesting second place.
Odoxa-Mascaret (Public Sénat/PQR), fieldwork 20–21 May 2026, n=1,005, tested Bardella (32%) rather than Le Pen by name in this period.
